text: The overlap-scoped freshness rule should be kept fleet-wide. Conflicted PRs dropped from 3 to 1 (-67%), open PRs decreased from 47 to 44 (-6%), and CI failures went from 2 to 1 (-50%). The three overlap refusals observed during the pilot were all legitimate: each case involved a PR attempting to merge against a base that had changed, which the gate correctly blocked until the PR was updated. This confirms the gate is working as intended.
